capabilities: Hide all notes in configured folders from the graph view
Reveal a node's hidden linked notes on hover or click
Cascade reveals from newly shown nodes during a session
Pin revealed nodes and open the underlying note on a second click
Cap the number of nodes revealed per interaction in settings
disambiguation: Not a worldbuilding or lore-writing tool; despite the name, it only filters which notes show in the graph view.
extras: Early development (v0.1.0) and not yet in the community plugin list, so manual installation is required. It hooks undocumented internal graph renderer APIs, which the README warns may break on Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: Hide whole folders from Obsidian's graph view and reveal their notes on demand
motivation: The author's second-brain graph drowned in daily and topic notes, turning the view into noise, so they built a way to hide those folders while keeping the links one click away.
problem: In Obsidian's graph view, vaults full of daily and journal notes become unreadable because every node connects to everything.
summary: Graph view enhancement that hides configured folders' notes and reveals a node's hidden linked notes on demand when the node is hovered or clicked.
